svg.title: FIG-12 Separate docs / SDK / evidence recovery independent payloads, actual external receipts
svg.desc: docs: HTML / local diagrams / editable DOT doc-source and software-evidence identity; Source SDK: complete installed prefix source / dependencies / license closure; candidate and evidence: same source/config/image scope reports and original execution logs; delivery.package -> verify Manifest excludes itself and checksums Archive hash is recorded in the outer receipt; package_source_sdk.prepare / verify Source/dependency manifests and required-file closure Actual consumers establish only their software scope; candidate.py / proof.py → store.export_tree candidate proof then evidence archive revalidate scope and preserve byte closure archival is not test re-execution; delivery.publish: versions/<release-id> / stable Trusted deployment selects an immutable verified documentation version; delivery owner stores immutable SDK package stable download index and archive receipt; Delivery owner stores complete content-ID archive + outer receipt Independent long-term storage beyond short-lived CI artifacts; delivery.post_deploy: actual HTTP site and downloads Verify manifest / stable / payload / archive; Download the complete SDK independently Verify archive hash and member path / size / hash; store.verify_external: actual independently stored evidence Verify archive / inventory / all payload bytes; delivery.restore -> new root Verify offline HTML / anchors / local diagrams / downloads; Restore the full prefix to a new root, then SDK verify Build independent consumers; actually run Native; store.restore_tree -> new root, then verify Verify scope proof and same-artifact refs No new HIL or product qualification; Record actual publication / download / restoration separately Absent actions remain not_executed; any failure prevents promotion; docs-only payload; validated; actual deployment URL; downloaded identical package; doc results; SDK-only payload; validated for this scope; actual storage location; full prefix, not just source subtree; SDK consumer results; candidate and full evidence closure; actual scope proof validated; actual storage and receipt; reject missing / changed / unsafe paths; evidence restoration results
